headline: Equinor Raises Production Outlook as Profit Hits Four-Year High
summary: Equinor raised its production outlook as quarterly profit reached its highest level in nearly four years.
why: Upward revisions to production guidance by major energy producers signal confidence in asset performance and cash flow generation.

impacts.name: Equinor ASA
impacts.why: Higher production guidance combined with multi-year high profits signals strong operational cash flow capabilities.
